andrea: Heads-up — I'm seeing a recurring perf + correctness flake on main after enabling the fp8 matmul dispatch for activation paths. Repro: GPT-ish model, batch=4, seq=1024, KV reuse. Outputs diverge silently (small but growing logits).
andrea: Quick repro command I used: `./tools/run_perf --model gpt-j-6B --dtype fp8 --batch 4 --seq 1024 --profile --kv-cache`
andrea: Relevant config snippet:```json
{
  "matmul_policy": "auto",
  "activation_quant": "fp8",
  "kv_cache": true
}
```
devin: Can you paste a minimal repro (single script) and exact commit? also which kernel binary (cuda driver / cuBLAS variant)? :eyes:
andrea: commit 1a2b3c4 (runtime: matmul-dispatch), CUDA 12.1 + custom fp8 kernels v2.
sasha: Profiling quick notes: flamegraph points to matmul_forward in layer 5/6. When kv hits are high, throughput looks OK but we occasionally see `scale_mismatch` warnings in logs (rare). snippet:```
W runtime/matmul.cpp:512 scale mismatch detected (s_a=0.00312, s_b=0.00624)
```
matt: Observed behavior: if first attention matmul goes fp8 and subsequent key/val matmuls go bf16 (or vice versa) we sometimes get tiny mis-scaling in packed KV buffers. Looks like the KV packing expects consistent quant scale across layers when reusing cached KV.
ci-bot: build/test:matrix-matmul (main) failed 3 tests in mixed-precision suite — see CI job 4545.
runtime-oncall: Short mitigation: can we force activation matmuls with kv_cache ON to bf16 until we triage? :thinking:
devin: Quick mitigation patch idea: change matmul_dispatch to prefer bf16 when `kv_cache==true && dtype==fp8` for attention kernels. Cheap and low-risk. microbench: fp8 matmul is ~1.35x faster than bf16 for long seq, but correctness wins for now.
andrea: Dropped a tiny patch:```diff
- if (policy == AUTO) choose_fp8();
+ if (policy == AUTO && !(kv_cache && is_attention)) choose_fp8();
```
andrea: Patch CI green locally (unit+smoke) but I want more tests for intermittent divergence.
sasha: Suggest adding a runtime assert in the packing layer: check that per-layer quant_scale == kv_header.scale when reading cached KV and log an error with layer id, shapes. If mismatch -> fallback to bf16 path and increment telemetry counter.
matt: Ran an experiment: baseline (all-fp8) throughput 720 toks/s, corrected fallback-to-bf16 throughput 540 toks/s (for seq=1024 batch=4). So ~25% perf hit when forced fallback. Still acceptable as a stopgap.
andrea: Good. I'll add the assert+telemetry and the conservative dispatch change. Also request a bisect: suspect the regression landed between commits 1a2b3c4..1a2b3d0 (dispatch rewrite). Anyone can pick up?
devin: I'll bisect today and report back. Please tag me for any reproducer infra I need.
andrea: Thanks — I'll push the temporary guard to canary after CI, and we can iterate on a proper fix (ensure quant scale propagation + kernel-level checks). :thumbsup:
matt: FYI, I added a smoke in perf harness that runs 100 random seeds with kv reuse; reproducer rate ~ 3/100 seeds. leaving it running.
sasha: Also opened PERF-987 in our tracker for longer-term solution (kernel-level scale sync and unit tests).
andrea: OK — moving to canary. keep eyes on tracing/regen alerts.
